# feat(hfp-016): move excerpts to a new version of a transcript

## Task

Transcripts never change after upload. A corrected file becomes a new version (`replaces_transcript_id`, ADR 0004). Today, quotes (excerpts) tagged on the old version stay on it. Re-anchor them on the new version by finding the exact quoted text, and flag any that can't be found for the researcher to review.

Not urgent. Only useful once people upload corrected transcripts.

## Parent Story

Data model (ADR 0004). "Later" in `notes/task-list.md`.

## Blocked by

- #34 HFP-011 (transcript upload and versions)
- #37 HFP-014 (excerpts with segment and offsets)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Uploading a new version offers to move excerpts from the version it replaces.
- [ ] Each excerpt whose exact text is found once in the new version is moved (new segment + offsets). Its tags, insight links and rating links follow.
- [ ] Excerpts found zero times or more than once are listed for review, not guessed.
- [ ] The move runs in one transaction; server tests cover found, missing and ambiguous excerpts.
